description: Retrieve TBA notables insights for a season, or all-time with year 0: lists of teams with notable achievements such as Hall of Fame membership, Championship wins, division wins, and Impact Award finals. Each entry gives a team key and the event keys where it earned the notable.

anyOf.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

year.description: FRC season year the insights cover (1992 through next calendar year), or 0 for all-time insights across every season.

name: get_insights_notables
title: Get Season Notables
